name: cursor-subagents
description: Delegate coding tasks from Codex to Cursor CLI with Grok 4.6 high and YOLO full local access.

interface.shortDescription: Delegate coding tasks to Cursor CLI from Codex
interface.longDescription: One skill for launching Cursor CLI as a coding subagent. Every run uses YOLO with sandbox disabled and workspace trust. Includes bounded tasks, exact-session follow-ups, separate worktrees for parallel writers, and verification. Defaults to cursor-grok-4.6-high without fast mode. Requires an installed, authenticated Cursor CLI.
defaultPrompt: Use $cursor-subagents for a second code review.
Use $cursor-subagents to fix a failing test.
